title: Count Days Without Meetings
summary: Given a positive integer representing the total number of workdays starting from day 1, and a 2D array of meeting schedules where each meeting is defined by a start and end day, count the number of days the employee is available and has no meetings scheduled.
statement: Given a positive integer representing the total number of workdays starting from day 1, and a 2D array of meeting schedules where each meeting is defined by a start and end day, count the number of days the employee is available and has no meetings scheduled. Note that the meetings can overlap.
constraints: Days are numbered inclusively from one through days; meetings may be empty.
Each meeting [start,end] occupies every day in that inclusive interval, and meetings may overlap.
Return the number of days not covered by any meeting.
hints: Only the union of meeting intervals matters; overlapping days must be counted once.
Sort intervals and merge each overlap or adjacency into the current covered block.
Accumulate inclusive lengths of finished merged blocks; subtract total covered from days.
The sorted scan partitions the union into disjoint maximal intervals whose lengths sum to exactly the occupied-day count.
editorial: The sorted scan partitions the union into disjoint maximal intervals whose lengths sum to exactly the occupied-day count.

tests.explanation: The meetings cover days 1–3, 5–7, and 9–10, leaving days 4 and 8.
The first meeting already covers every workday, so none are free.
